text:
maria: Quick FYI — I want to tweak inference-api StatefulSet to increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds from 30 -> 120 and add a preStop that sleeps 60s so the model server can flush KV cache and finish async checkpoints. We've seen a couple of 503s during pod restarts when the cache flush overlaps eviction.
cheng: Can you paste the proposed manifest diff?
maria: Sure, short snippet below:
```
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120
      containers:
      - name: model
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command: ["/bin/sh","-c","sleep 60"]
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
```
Also planning to reduce replicas from 6 -> 4 for the canary window to avoid partial hot-shard issues while we validate.
alex: Changing termination/grace periods is fine, but dropping replicas will affect throughput. Are we coupling this with HPA or manual scaling?
maria: Manual for the short canary (1h). We'll revert after smoke. HPA stays, we're not changing target metrics.
cheng: One more: TF state shows we've renamed labels on the service earlier (app: inference -> service: inference-api). That means the StatefulSet selector in k8s might not match and could create a second set of pods during rollout. Did you update Terraform?
maria: Good catch — I didn't. I think we need a small TF patch to sync `kubernetes_stateful_set.v1.metadata[0].labels` and the service selector. Otherwise the rollout will orphan old pods.
alex: If you change labels in TF you'll need to plan/apply carefully. We should use `kubernetes_manifest` replacement strategy or annotate for a controlled rolling update.
maria: Plan: open TF PR that updates labels, add `rollingUpdate.partition` to force one-by-one replacement, and the preStop change. I'll draft the PR.
cheng: I can take the TF PR. I'll add an automated `terraform state mv` note if needed and a pre-apply run in staging.
ops-sre: Heads-up from SRE: if terminationGrace > 60 we should increase the pod eviction timeout in the node group's drain config to avoid race conditions with cloud provider SIGKILL. Also add a readiness probe tweak so endpoints are removed prior to termination.
maria: Good point — will bump `graceful_termination` in the drain job and extend readiness probe failureThreshold from 3->5 with a slightly longer initialDelay.
alex: One more thing: secret mount path changed in the new image (from /etc/creds to /run/creds). Does the StatefulSet volume mount reflect that? If not pods will crash on start and the canary will fail.
maria: It's updated in the container spec here; TF secret volume needs a path change. I'll include that in the PR.
cheng: I'll run a staging apply after your PR is up, then run a small smoke test: 100 inference requests / 5m and monitor tail-latency and error-rate.
maria: Thanks. I'll post the PR link when ready. Deploy-bot: canary deployment created for inference-api v2.3-rc (namespace=prod-staging). :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary pods: 2/2 ready, rollingUpdate.partition=5 -> starting replacement.
alex: pinging @ops-sre for monitoring alert adjustments (token-per-second SLO might spike).
ops-sre: Acknowledged — I'll add a temporary alert threshold increase for the canary window and watch the dashboards.
maria: TL;DR — TF PR to sync labels + secret path, k8s manifest changes: terminationGrace=120, preStop sleep 60, readiness fail threshold up, replicas temporarily 4. Cheng will apply to staging and run smoke tests. Will revert replicas after validation. Thanks.
